title: Visiting a Museum
text:
A museum brochure gives you useful information before your visit. It shows the opening hours, the ticket prices and a map of the rooms. Some brochures also list the best exhibitions to see.

Brochures are usually free at the front desk. You can take one home and read it later. If you have questions, you can ask the staff at the entrance.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does a museum brochure show?
options: Opening hours, ticket prices and a map

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, where are brochures usually free?
Why might a visitor take a brochure home?
options: To read the information again later
To sell it to other visitors
To use it as a ticket
To give it back to the museum staff

questions.text: What can you infer about the museum staff?
options: They can help visitors who have questions
They do not work at the museum

vocabulary.definition: events where objects such as art are shown to the public
the place where you go into a building
the people who work in an organization

paragraph_translations: Буклет музею дає вам корисну інформацію перед візитом. Він показує години роботи, ціни на квитки та план кімнат. Деякі буклети також перелічують найкращі виставки, які варто побачити.
Буклети зазвичай безкоштовні на стійці реєстрації. Ви можете взяти один додому і прочитати пізніше. Якщо у вас є запитання, ви можете запитати персонал біля входу.
